metaDescription: Studio Noor designs calm, liveable interiors for homes, cafes and workplaces. See the portfolio and book a consultation.

hero.title: Rooms that feel
hero.sub: We design homes, cafes and workplaces that are easy to live in, with honest materials, soft light and furniture that lasts.
hero.proof: Every project starts with a visit to your room, not a catalogue.
hero.alt: Illustration of a calm living room with a sofa, lamps and framed art

benefits.title: Design for real life, not for photos

items.title: Rooms planned around you
items.body: We start with how you live, cook, work and rest, then draw the room around that.

items.title: Honest materials
items.body: Wood, stone, linen and plaster that age well, chosen with you, never hidden in a quote.

items.title: One designer throughout
items.body: The same designer visits, draws, orders and checks the finished room with you.

items.title: A clear schedule
items.body: You get a written plan with dates for drawings, deliveries and installation.

tagline: A room should hold your day gently. Morning light on the table, a chair that fits your back, and nothing shouting for attention.

how.title: From your room to a room you love

steps.title: Visit and listen
steps.body: We visit your room, measure it, and talk about how you live and what you want to change.

steps.title: Design and samples
steps.body: You receive drawings, a mood board and real material samples to touch before anything is ordered.

steps.title: Make and install
steps.body: We order, follow the makers, and install the room with you, then adjust the small things together.

faq.title: Questions clients ask before we start

items.q: How long does one room take?
items.a: A single room usually takes four to six weeks from visit to installation, depending on furniture lead times.

items.q: Do you work with furniture we already own?
items.a: Yes. We keep the pieces you love and plan the room around them, then add only what is missing.

items.q: Can I see materials before ordering?
items.a: Yes. Samples come to your home, and nothing is ordered until you have touched and approved them.

items.q: Do you handle the builders and makers?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate the makers and the installation, and we check the finished work with you.
The first consultation is free. Design fees are agreed in writing after we have seen the room.

items.q: Do you design cafes and offices too?
items.a: Yes. We design cafes, restaurants and workplaces, with layouts planned around staff and customers.
